name: ControlPreset
meaning: Progress+0x9a, switched by Input_ApplyControlConfig 0x55ecc8. Map slots 0xc/0xd/0xe/0xf/0xb/0xa get the listed PadButton masks

name: CTRL_PRESET_A
meaning: Triangle, Circle, Cross, Square, R1, L1 (the defaults in g_padMasks)

name: CTRL_PRESET_B
meaning: Square, Triangle, Circle, Cross, R1, L1

name: CTRL_PRESET_C
meaning: Cross, Square, Triangle, Circle, R1, L1
